title: The Company Dissolution Party
subtitle_source: subs_resolved/0987.txt (259 dialogue lines, full transcript read)
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Inspector Megure, Takagi) omitted by convention. case_type: murder (double homicide -- Koshimoto secretly poisons company president Kureno, then Narita kills Koshimoto in a rage upon learning this). Correction vs. old cases/ep987 file: the old file's culprit id (Narita) and core clue (only suspect without a corroborated alibi) both hold up against the transcript, so no culprit/clue reversal here -- but the old file was structurally broken: it never created a node for the first victim, company president Kureno Jiro, at all. It mislabeled its lone victim node 'v1' with Koshimoto's name while its own event text describes Koshimoto poisoning 'him' (the president) -- i.e. it conflated perpetrator-of-murder-1 and victim-of-murder-2 into one row and dropped Kureno entirely. This rebuild adds Kureno as p1 (poisoning victim) and keeps Koshimoto as p2 (poisoner of Kureno, then strangled by Narita). Also added: the restaurant waitress who corroborates Kamijo's alibi (unnamed but individualized on-screen witness), full was_at coverage for all named persons across the party room / hallway / restroom / back room, and the red-herring motive accusations suspects leveled at each other (Toda vs. Kamijo, Narita vs. Toda) that the old file omitted.

clues.desc: Restaurant staff testimony: a tall man was seen crouched over the bouquet fiddling with it during the meal -- points to Koshimoto (tall), not bouquet-preparer Toda, as the one who hid the needle.

The skin is raised just inside the ligature marks on Koshimoto's neck, showing he was strangled twice: once with something much thinner than the wine napkin, then again with the napkin to mask the real weapon.
Narita's bag strap matches the true (thinner) ligature marks on Koshimoto's neck exactly.
A faint drag-smudge on the back room floor plus Koshimoto's shoe left behind show his body was dragged to the door post-mortem -- the murder was unplanned and staged as suicide afterward.

Of the three suspects who each left the party room after Koshimoto did, Toda's alibi (met the boy during a phone call) and Kamijo's alibi (with the waitress in the hallway) are both corroborated; Narita's claimed restroom trip is the only one nobody witnesses.
